WarriorCombo1.text: Stylized fantasy action game sound effect, punchy and clean, dry close mic, no music, no voice. A quick one-handed sword slash cutting through the air, sharp light metallic whoosh.

WarriorCombo2.text: Stylized fantasy action game sound effect, punchy and clean, dry close mic, no music, no voice. A fast backhand sword swing, airy whoosh with a slightly lower tone and a faint blade ring.

WarriorCombo3.text: Stylized fantasy action game sound effect, punchy and clean, dry close mic, no music, no voice. A heavy two-handed overhead sword swing, deep powerful whoosh ending in a strong ground-slam thud.

Dodge.text: Stylized fantasy action game sound effect, punchy and clean, dry close mic, no music, no voice. A very quick light dash, short cloth swish and air whoosh.

Impact.text: Stylized fantasy action game sound effect, punchy and clean, dry close mic, no music, no voice. A sword blade hitting a target, solid crisp thwack with a short bright metal ring.
